requirement_text: Internally to the CPN a CNG transmitting private or other critical information (i.e. to a CND) shall protect the data from unauthorised disclosure.
label: NFR

requirement_text: Internally to the CPN a CNG receiving private or other critical information (i.e. from a CND) should verify that the data was protected from unauthorised disclosure.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall detect the end of the life of the key used for cryptographic protection of the wireless communication between the CND and the CNG.
label: NFR

requirement_text: A CPN-user attempting to invoke a CNG-mediated service shall be identified and authenticated by the CNG before being granted access to the service.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall implement an authentication failure handling policy.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall take action according to local authentication failure handling policy (which may include silently discarding the authentication and explicit failure notification or in the case of a replay of credentials may include notification of the true owner of the credentials) upon detection of failure during identification authentication and authorization.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG should detect replayed user and/or device credentials.
label: NFR

requirement_text: When the CNG detects replayed user and/or device credentials the CNG shall stop the relevant processes.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall implement a privacy protection policy specifying as a minimum private and critical information.
label: NFR

requirement_text: When the CNG detects violation of the privacy protection policy the CNG shall discard all signalling including signalling from the NGN.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall implement an authorization management handling policy.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On reception at the CNG of a message to access configuration information for update and detection of authorization failure the CNG shall reject the request and manage the failure in accordance with the CPN authorization management handling policy.
label: NFR

requirement_text: Where a CND invokes a session at the CNG the CNG shall record the association of session-id invoking device identity and invoking user-id.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On transmission of management information from the CNG to a CND the CNG shall append a timestamp or sequence number to the outgoing message.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On reception at the CNG of a message containing management information the CNG shall extract the timestamp or sequence number and verify that the message has not been replayed.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On reception at the CNG of a message to access or update configuration information the CNG shall allow access only if the sender is an administrator.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On detection of a message integrity error at the CNG the CNG shall discard the message.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On indication received at the CNG of a resource allocation expiry the CNG shall delete all residual data associated with the invocation of the resource.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On receipt of a valid (i.e. authorized) request for data stored in the CNG the CNG shall return the requested data to the requesting user.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On receipt of a valid (i.e. authorized) request for access to a CNG hosted service or application the CNG shall provide the requested service or application to the requesting user.
label: NFR

requirement_text: On detection of any system failure or discontinuity not specifically handled by other mechanisms the CNG shall revert to a known safe state.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support mechanisms to authenticate itself to the NGN for connectivity purposes.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support mechanisms to authenticate itself to the NGN for service usage purposes.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support mechanisms to authenticate CNDs to the NGN for service usage purposes if they are not able to fully support the related procedures in an autonomous way.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support mechanisms for authentication of wireless CNDs for local connectivity. Similar mechanisms may be also implemented for non-wireless devices.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG and CPN shall support mechanisms that prevent access to the network by unauthorized users.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The capacity of the authorized entities should depend on the security policies defined by the service providers managing the CNG.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG and the CPN shall implement mechanisms to limit the visibility of the WAN side network and resources to authorized entities.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The diagnostic operations on the CPN by an operator shall be performed in accordance with rules protecting the users' privacy.
label: NFR

requirement_text: CPN environment shall be protected with a stateful firewall function that may be implemented in the CNG.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG and the CPN shall be able to support parental control related functionalities limiting the use of the broadband connection on a user or time basis. Limitations on a content basis may be shared with devoted network servers.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall be equipped with a WAN interface towards the NGN implementing layer 1 and 2 functionalities ("one-box" solution).
label: FR

requirement_text: LAN interfaces. The CNG shall be equipped with at least one Ethernet (minimum 100 Mbit/s) is interface. Optional interfaces could be present e.g.: wireless LAN Wi-Fi Alliance certified Powerlines Plastic Optical Fiber USB device and/or host one or more FXS for analog telephony DECT Cat-iq.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support both routed and bridged modes of operation.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support direct intra-LAN connectivity between any appropriate pair of devices on the Customer Premises Network.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support different IP address schemes and subnets on the same physical LAN port and on different LAN ports irrespective of routed or bridged mode of operation allowing the direct addressability of CNDs from the NGN side in relation to data plane control plane and management plane flows.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support use of one user identity on several terminals as well as to share one terminal with several identities.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG and the Customer Network shall support the NGN services usage (e.g. voice communications video communications IPTV entertainment …) allowing the connection to the right service control platforms.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG should support redirection of IP Multimedia sessions as defined by TS 181 005 [1] independently from the type of device used (NGN terminal or other CND).
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG and the Customer Network shall assure the confidentiality the integrity of signalling/control/media and management flows.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG should negotiate session parameters (bandwidth screen resolution codecs…) with the NGN transparently to the user.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CPN shall support remote access based on NGN network functions.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall allow the customer remote access to a CND in the Customer Network for example a surveillance video camera.
label: FR

requirement_text: Standard NGN authentication routing and connectivity should be used to establish remote access connectivity.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG may use multiple tunnel connections for providing e.g. adequate QoS for the remote access user.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG may allow secure dynamic firewall opening for remote access devices based on NGN authentication functions.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG may provide Home to Home (H2H) communication service connecting CNDs in different CPNs.
label: FR

requirement_text: If Home to Home (H2H) communication service is provided then each CNG must limit access to local CNDs and/or media classes based on the access rights of the remote H2H user identity.
label: NFR

requirement_text: If Home to Home (H2H) communication service is provided then each CNG must ensure that emergency service sessions originating in its CPN are associated with the appropriate location information and/or calling identity.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CPN may support encrypted communication with remote access devices and the encrypted communication can be terminated either at the CNG or CND.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG may act as a proxy for handling messages (requests and responses) related to the remote access scenarios to and from the home.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG may support mechanisms supporting nomadism of the users and their subscribed services from one physical customer environment to another.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG should be able to assist in establishing Rich Communication Suite sessions between CNDs including joining/splitting voice & media streams.
label: FR

requirement_text: It should be possible for more than one identity to be associated with a single CPN subscription.
label: FR

requirement_text: It should be possible for a service profile to be associated with each identity within a CPN subscription.
label: NFR

requirement_text: It shall be possible for a single public identity to be associated with multiple CNDs where each association is allocated a unique private identity.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support a mechanism allowing the support of call forking towards customer non-IMS capable devices.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall able to store information related to private identities of non-IMS capable CNDs.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support a mechanism allowing the support of call forwarding toward non-IMS capable CNDs.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support intra-CPN communication between IMS and non-IMS capable CNDs.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support mechanisms for managing IPTV flows provided both in unicast and multicast mode.
label: FR

requirement_text: In case of multicast flows the CNG shall keep a record of which devices are subscribed to which multicast group.
label: FR

requirement_text: An IPTV media flow shall be terminated by a STB or by a specific device called "media gateway" (or "application gateway"). The CNG shall not terminate any IPTV flow by itself.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support the connection to a STB (or media gateway) both in a bridged or in a routed mode of operation.
label: FR

requirement_text: Depending on the operation mode chosen (bridged or touted) and on the type of flow treated (unicast or multicast) the CNG shall forward packets only to the physical interfaces which are connected to devices interested to the IPTV flow.
label: FR

requirement_text: In case of multicast streams the CNG should support proxy functionalities to optimize the management of information related to signalling.
label: FR

requirement_text: CNG shall perform a link layer multicast to unicast translation if the STB or media gateway are connected using customer network technologies not supporting multicast flows (e.g. powerlines wireless).
label: FR

requirement_text: Functionalities related to Electronic Programming Guide and DRM management shall be implemented in STB or media gateway and not in CNG.
label: FR

requirement_text: Media flows (data plane) transcoding shall be performed by STB or media gateway and not by the CNG.
label: FR

requirement_text: Protocols adaptation for control plane or management plane may be performed by CNG.
label: FR

requirement_text: Presence related information shall be sent to the NGN by the STB or the CNG (depending on the specific architectural choices CNG could manage the presence related information on behalf of the specific device used) to enable specific services tailored on the specific user's profile.
label: FR

requirement_text: CPN should support user generated content (UGC) using an NGN service.
label: FR

requirement_text: CPN should support storage of UGC within the CPN.
label: FR

requirement_text: Subject to applicable regulation UGC media streams may be sent directly from one CPN to one or multiple other CPN.
label: FR

requirement_text: CPN should support bookmarks (e.g. hyperlinks) to stored and streaming user-generated content in order to store and exchange references to uploaded and streaming UGC.
label: FR

requirement_text: The user should be able to personalize bookmarks to UGC.
label: NFR

requirement_text: CPN should support inter-destination content synchronisation of streaming multimedia content. This should achieve that all or a specific group of users consuming specific content get the content presented simultaneously i.e. without user-noticeable delay difference.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG and the CPN shall support adequate Quality of Service mechanisms (e.g. prioritize the traffic in the event that there is not sufficient bandwidth in the customer network in order to ensure the correct network performances to each traffic flow). To achieve this objective a number of functionalities shall be supported by CNG and/or CNDs as defined in the following bullets. Most of the following set of requirements is defined adopting as a reference the Home Gateway Initiative (HGI) Release 1 Specification mentioned in clause 2 [6].
label: NFR

requirement_text: The NGN network QoS functions shall be possible to use to enhance the end-user experience.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG may interact with the Resource and Admission Control Subsystem (RACS) as defined in ES 282 001 [9] to support remote real-time QoS control
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG may interact with network elements inside the CPN to support QoS control inside the CPN.
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CNG shall be able to classify intra-LAN traffic that is simply bridged by the CNG itself within the CPN.
label: NFR

requirement_text: Traffic marking: depending on what are the parameters used to perform classification CNDs or CNG itself on behalf of the CNDs shall be able to modify the packets' priority.
label: NFR

requirement_text: In case of huge amount of traffic in upstream or downstream directions a congestion management mechanism shall be implemented in the CNG to minimize the impact from the user experience point of view.
label: NFR

requirement_text: In case of managed services QoS rules applied by CNG shall be configurable by a remote management system.
label: NFR

requirement_text: In case of unmanaged services user shall be able to access a QoS configuration function implemented in the CNG.
label: FR

requirement_text: CNG shall be equipped with an application client to be remotely manageable by the service providers for configuration monitoring firmware upgrade purposes. In case of multiple service providers multiple clients configuring different sets of parameters (for example referring to different services) may be present. A single parameter can be modified by a single client only.
label: FR

requirement_text: CNG shall support mechanisms for secure authentication and communication with the remote management system.
label: NFR

requirement_text: A suitably authorized CPN user (e.g. the system administrator) shall be able to install and activate NGN managed services without the intervention of the subscribing CPN user.
label: FR

requirement_text: A suitably authorized CPN user (e.g. the system administrator) shall be able to manage and configure the provisioning capabilities and use of NGN managed services from an NGN access point outside the CPN.
label: FR

requirement_text: A CPN user shall be able to configure any unmanaged service provided to the user.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG Remote Management requires to manage a specific set of parameters. At least the following list of parameters shall be available: Customer Identification Physical Line Identification list of subscribed services CNG IP address.
label: FR

requirement_text: For the CNG management it is recommended to use a single protocol so as to minimize the complexity and the cost of the service.
label: NFR

requirement_text: CNDs connected to the CPN and devoted to specific NGN managed services shall be remotely manageable.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CPN (trough CNDs and/or CNG) shall support manual configuration to insert information to access IMS network (e.g. IMPU IMPI Shared keys Home Network Domain or P-CSCF IP Address etc.).
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND directly or through the CNG must be able to access to Network Configuration Service Function without involving any user interaction.
label: FR

requirement_text: The Network Configuration Server should be able to upload different parameter sets related to service subscription.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND should be able to support bootstrap capabilities in order to retrieve network configuration data to connect the NGN.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND/CNG shall support a mechanism allowing the user to manually modify the association between a public identity (e.g. phone number) and a specific private identity corresponding to a single customer device not provided with a UICC and corresponding also to legal service level agreements between the user and the service provider.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CPN (CND and/or CNG) shall support a method to access a Self Configuration Server.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CPN should support a capability to ensure QoS and call prioritization for sessions originating or terminating in the H(e)NB.
label: NFR

requirement_text: A CND as defined in clause 3 may use the CNG to access NGN services.
label: FR

requirement_text: Authorized users shall be able to access NGN-based services using any NGN supported home device.
label: FR

requirement_text: Both IMS capable devices with or without UICC and non-IMS capable devices without UICC shall be supported.
label: FR

requirement_text: If the CND contains an ISIM/UICC it shall support the AKA authentication method (TS 187 001 [8])
label: FR

requirement_text: If the CND does not contain an ISIM/UICC it shall support the HTTP Digest authentication or the NBA
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND shall provide its registration identity when it requires the registration to the network.
label: FR

requirement_text: In order to support the NGN services and intra-CPN communications all the CNDs in the CPN shall be addressable directly or by the mean of the CNG using L2/L3 mechanisms.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND should support protocols for remote access management.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND should support protocol for local authentication in CPN/CNG.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND shall support the NGN services usage (e.g. voice communications video communications IPTV entertainment etc.) allowing the connection to the right service control platforms to process the media.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND shall support protocol to access the NGN service layer platforms.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND shall support protocols to access Self Configuration application (as defined in clause 4.1).
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND shall be able to download and install client application services.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND should be able to communicate its services related capabilities to the CNG.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND should be able to support one or more codecs for communication services (as defined by TS 181 005 [1]).
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG should support or not prevent redirection of IP Multimedia sessions as defined by TS 181 005 [1] independently from the type of device used (NGN terminal or other CND).
label: FR

requirement_text: The CPN shall support secure remote access control based on NGN network functions.
label: NFR

requirement_text: Multiple identities should be supported within the same subscription. Personal service profiles per each identity within the same subscription should be supported. A shared public identity on several terminals with different private identities shall be supported (shared IMPU).
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support a mechanism allowing the support of call forking towards customer non-IMS capable devices and shall able to store information related to private identities of non-IMS capable CNDs.
label: FR

requirement_text: (i.e. using the same CND in two different CPNs declaring the same public identity). Supporting this scenario for non IMS capable CNDs is still to be discussed.
label: FR

requirement_text: CNG shall be able to classify intra-LAN traffic that is simply bridged by the CNG itself within the CPN.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall be equipped with an application client to be remotely manageable by the service providers for configuration monitoring firmware upgrade purposes. In case of multiple service providers multiple clients configuring different sets of parameters (for example referring to different services) may be present. A single parameter can be modified by a single client only.
label: FR

requirement_text: The CNG shall support mechanisms for secure authentication and communication with the remote management system.
label: NFR

requirement_text: In case of managed services the CNG shall support zero-touch provisioning to activate new services starting from Internet access to voice and video services and shall be remotely manageable. In case of unmanaged services the user shall be able to configure the CNG by himself.
label: FR

requirement_text: CNDs connected to the CPN and devoted to specific managed services shall be remotely manageable
label: FR

requirement_text: (e.g. VoIP phones Video phones STBs etc).
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND directly or through the CNG must be able to access to Network Configuration Service Function avoiding any user interaction. (and so the Network Configuration Server should be able to upload different parameter related to service subscription).
label: FR

requirement_text: The CND/CNG shall support a mechanism allowing the user to manually modify the association between a public identity (e.g. phone number) and a specific private identity corresponding to a single customer device not provided with a UICC.
label: FR

requirement_text: Successful authentication is a prerequisite for the processing of any on-line or offline CEPS transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: On-line authentication must take place between the card issuer and the CEP card for load unload and currency exchange transactions
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card issuer and the CEP card share a secret key to generate and verify MACs
label: NFR

requirement_text: Off-line authentication must take place between a PSAM in the POS device and the CEP card for purchase and cancel last purchase transactions
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card and the PSAM must use a public key algorithm for mutual authentication and session key exchange as no permanent shared secret key may exist between the CEP card and the PSAM
label: NFR

requirement_text: To load value into a slot of the CEP card securely the load device establishes a connection between the issuer and the CEP card
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card should use a unique diversified secret key personalized into the card to generate and authenticate transaction signatures
label: NFR

requirement_text: If this is not a cash load the funds issuer needs to verify that the funds are requested by the legitimate account owner which is normally done by the presentation of an enciphered PIN
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card issuer needs to ensure that the load acquirer is guaranteeing payment for the electronic value and that the card is authentic
label: NFR

requirement_text: The load acquirer needs to ensure that the issuer is the true owner of the card and in the case of an apparent failure of the load the load acquirer needs the card presented to authenticate the failure
label: NFR

requirement_text: The load device sends S1 in an authorization request to the issuer
label: NFR

requirement_text: The load device also provides for verification of the identity of the cardholder (with either on-line or off-line PIN verification) and forwards verification data in the authorization request
label: NFR

requirement_text: The issuer validates S1 to authenticate the card and the data to be used in the transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: The issuer sends S2 to the load acquirer in the authorization response message
label: NFR

requirement_text: Unloads are permitted only to an account controlled by the card issuer and are performed only at a load device under the control of the card issuer
label: NFR

requirement_text: The cardholder must have an account relationship with the card issuer and funds removed from the card are credited to the cardholder account only after the card issuer authenticates the card
label: NFR

requirement_text: The issuer needs only to authenticate the card and the card needs only to authenticate the issuer and that the data is the same as used by the issuer
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card generates S1 using data from the card and load device and sends S1 to the card issuer to authenticate the card and the data that is to be used in the transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card issuer generates S2 which is sent to the card to allow the card to validate the card issuerƒ??s authenticity and to ensure that the data used by the card in the transaction is the same as the card issuer intended
label: NFR

requirement_text: In the case of an unsuccessful completion exception processing outlined in the On-line Exception Processing section is performed
label: NFR

requirement_text: During a purchase transaction the CEP card must ensure that it is dealing with an authentic POS device and it must generate a signature to allow the card issuer to verify the integrity of the transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: The POS device must ensure that it is dealing with an authentic card and guarantee integrity of transactions and batches to the merchant acquirer
label: NFR

requirement_text: In the case of a reversal the CEP card must re-authenticate the PSAM
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card must ensure that the transaction is performed by the same POS device as was used for the purchase being canceled and that the amount of the cancellation is the same as the amount of the purchase or in the case of an incremental purchase the same as the amount of the last step
label: NFR

requirement_text: During a Cancel Last Purchase transaction the CEP card is authenticated by the PSAM in the POS device
label: NFR

requirement_text: The PSAM authenticates that the purchase transaction being canceled was performed by the PSAM and that the transaction being canceled is part of the active batch
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card issuer and the merchant acquirer also authenticate the transaction when they receive it
label: NFR

requirement_text: Transmissions between host systems should be protected by MACs based on unique keys that are shared by the nodes involved
label: NFR

requirement_text: The transaction signatures ensure end to end integrity of transmitted data for load unload and currency exchange transactions
label: NFR

requirement_text: These totals are used by the merchant acquirer to ensure the integrity of the batch
label: NFR

requirement_text: The count and amount of the transactions in the batch must be protected by the S4 MAC This information is not part of the card issuerƒ??s verification process
label: NFR

requirement_text: Scheme providers must assign unique identifying numbers to merchant acquirers who provide PSAMs
label: NFR

requirement_text: These merchant acquirers must then assign unique identifiers to PSAMs
label: NFR

requirement_text: Each PSAM must maintain a transaction count The unique PSAM ID and the transaction count are used during a conversation with a CEP card. The transaction count must not be reset during the life of the PSAM
label: NFR

requirement_text: Contain the CA public RSA key the PSAMƒ??s private RSA key and optionally the certificates that the POS device uses to perform mutual authentication with the CEP card
label: NFR

requirement_text: Perform the calculation required to generate a signature using the PSAMƒ??s private RSA key to allow the CEP card to validate the PSAM
label: NFR

requirement_text: Contain the latest transaction count and amount of batches that have not been deleted from the POS device by the merchant or merchant acquirer
label: FR

requirement_text: Contain the details of a transaction between the initialize command for that transaction and the initialize command for the next transaction
label: FR

requirement_text: Be the entity that maintains control over the flow of a transaction ensuring that all security is enforced
label: NFR

requirement_text: Perform the verification of signatures and certificates during a purchase and cancel last purchase transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: Ensure that each batch of transactions is cleared and settled once and only once
label: NFR

requirement_text: Send transactions to card issuers or their processors in a standard format defined in agreement with the scheme provider
label: FR

requirement_text: Ensure that CA public keys aggregation parameters blocking lists and issuer certificate revocation lists from the scheme providers are sent to the POS devices
label: NFR

requirement_text: Share one or more MAC keys with connecting processors create a MAC on each transmission sent to another processor and verify the MAC on each transmission received from another processor
label: NFR

requirement_text: Send transactions to other processors in a standard format defined in agreement with the scheme provider
label: FR

requirement_text: If a supported scheme provider has a dispute resolution process participate in that dispute resolution process with connecting processors to resolve any issues related to invalid transactions. These resolution processes should include a mechanism for repayment of funds associated with invalid transactions
label: NFR

requirement_text: The scheme provider must ensure that the entire process between merchants merchant acquirers card issuers and processors is auditable and reconcilable
label: NFR

requirement_text: If errors in the card issuer MAC are discovered by the card issuer during its processing of the transactions a dispute mechanism established by the scheme provider may be used to have money refunded
label: NFR

requirement_text: If a scheme provider establishes a central error repository all transactions for the scheme with MAC errors must be sent to that central error repository whether or not they are submitted to the dispute process
label: NFR

requirement_text: Payment for a transaction is only required when a detail transaction is submitted for payment A merchant acquirer may choose to pay the merchant using the batch total
label: FR

requirement_text: The timing of payment to the merchant must be established between the merchant and the merchant acquirer
label: NFR

requirement_text: A purchase transaction may be reversed prior to the removal of the CEP card from the POS device by sending a purchase reversal command to the CEP card The CEP card must authenticate the PSAM using certificates previously exchanged
label: NFR

requirement_text: The amount to be reversed is the amount of the last step of the transaction. The reversal command sent to the CEP card contains a S2 MAC computed by the PSAM
label: NFR

requirement_text: The PSAM in the POS device generates a merchant acquirer S5 MAC for the transaction computes a new S4 MAC on the updated batch total count and amount and logs the transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CEP card authenticates the PSAM using the certificates previously received and the S2 The CEP card increments the value of the purse and logs the transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CEP card sends a response to the reversal command to the POS device. The reversal is considered to be successful even in the event of a negative response or no response from the CEP card
label: FR

requirement_text: After the CEP card is inserted in the POS device the POS device initiates the cancel last purchase transaction
label: FR

requirement_text: If the POS device supports multiple applications or multiple transaction types an interaction between the terminal and consumer or sales agent determines the CEP application and the function to be performed (cancel last purchase transaction)
label: FR

requirement_text: The CEP card verifies that the PSAM is the PSAM used in the original transaction computes a S1 MAC using the same DES session key that was used for the purchase transaction being cancelled and responds to the POS device with the S1 and the identification of the last transaction. If the purchase transaction to be canceled has been canceled or is not part of the active batch the command is not allowed
label: NFR

requirement_text: The PSAM either retrieves or re-derives the DES session key used for the purchase transaction being cancelled. The POS device authenticates the CEP card using this key and the S1 MAC
label: NFR

requirement_text: The PSAM in the POS device generates a merchant acquirer S5 MAC for the transaction and a new S4 MAC for the batch total count and amount and logs the transaction. The amount of the canceled last purchase transaction is subtracted from the header amount. The transaction is kept in a data store associated with the POS device until the merchant acquirer collects it
label: NFR

requirement_text: A credit command which contains the S2 MAC computed by the PSAM using the session key is sent to the CEP card
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CEP card authenticates the terminal using the S2 MAC and the session key from the purchase transaction being cancelled. The CEP card increments the value of the purse and logs the transaction. The CEP card verifies that the cancellation amount is equal to the amount of the last step of the purchase transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: A transaction collection process must exist. Data being transmitted from the POS devices must be transmitted in a manner that ensures integrity of the data
label: NFR

requirement_text: The batch is sent to the merchant acquirer. Delivery may involve transmission to multiple intermediate locations or it may be direct to the merchant acquirer
label: FR

requirement_text: The merchant acquirer validates the batch to ensure that it has been transmitted correctly and enters it into the log
label: FR

requirement_text: If the business rules allow this transaction is to be aggregated the PSAM must determine if it has an aggregation record for the card issuer. If the PSAM does not have an aggregation record for the card issuer a new aggregation record for the card issuer must be created
label: FR

requirement_text: The aggregated totals by card issuer must be transmitted to the merchant acquirer at the same time and manner as the non-aggregated detail transactions in the batch
label: FR

requirement_text: Each POS transaction completed at the POS device is given a S5 MAC by the PSAM which is used by the merchant acquirer to validate that the transactions were made at a POS device with a valid PSAM. The batch total count and amount must be protected by the S4 MAC which must also be validated by the merchant acquirer
label: NFR

requirement_text: The merchant acquirer validates the PSAMƒ??s MACs prior to accepting the POS transactions for payment. In addition selected data elements are validated to ensure correct processing by the POS device and its PSAM
label: NFR

requirement_text: Each purchase transaction is signed by the CEP card with a S6 MAC which is used by the card issuer to validate that the transaction was made with a legitimate not counterfeit CEP card. The card issuer validates the CEP cardƒ??s MAC
label: NFR

requirement_text: Payment decisions are based on signature validations scheme provider rules and merchant and merchant acquirer agreements
label: NFR

requirement_text: After investigation if the merchant acquirer decides based on scheme rules to accept the transactions a method must exist to settle them and forward them to the card issuer
label: NFR

requirement_text: A transaction that passes merchant acquirer validations and is forwarded to the card issuer is paid for by the card issuer. If the transaction does not pass card issuer validations the card issuer may follow the scheme providerƒ??s dispute procedures
label: FR

requirement_text: Pay on detail is the default payment arrangement for merchant acquirers to provide payment to their merchants. In this arrangement the merchant acquirer relies on the POS transaction S5 MAC to determine acceptance. Merchants are paid only for valid POS transactions
label: NFR

requirement_text: POS transactions that were rejected for payment by the merchant acquirer are flagged with an error code indicating the type of validation failure and are forwarded to the card issuer for CEP card history information only
label: FR

requirement_text: All load transactions are on-line transactions. Authorization of funds for load transactions must require a form of cardholder verification. The load device must support on-line encrypted PIN or off-line PIN verification
label: NFR

requirement_text: Off-line PIN verification must include both encrypted and unencrypted PIN
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card verification method indicator (CVMI) in the CEP card must specify support of online PIN verification and at least one method of off-line PIN verification (encrypted or unencrypted)
label: NFR

requirement_text: Since these transactions are on-line to the issuer the issuer has the opportunity to lock the card or the application. These transactions are not available to a card that has already been locked
label: NFR

requirement_text: Card issuers must inform their cardholders as to which currencies they support in electronic purses
label: NFR

requirement_text: Load acquirers must determine the currencies that they must support for load transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: The CEP application must contain data that indicates the presence of a linked financial institution. If a linked financial institution is established for the CEP application then linked loads must be allowed and data in the application must indicate whether linked loads are supported
label: FR

requirement_text: Flexibility is required to accommodate the variety of environments where unlinked loads may be implemented. As a result the design specification must not preclude dual-leg transactions** from taking place either sequentially or in parallel. The design of a given implementation will vary depending on the device host and network capabilities
label: NFR

requirement_text: Unload and currency exchange transactions are optional for CEP card issuers. The CEP card must indicate whether the card issuer supports these transactions. However if a card issuer issues multi-currency capable cards it must provide its cardholder with a facility to remove any remaining value. As a result if a card issuer supports loading of multiple currencies onto a card then it must support the unload or currency exchange transaction or both
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card issuer must establish its policies for assigning and adjusting slot maximum balances. These policies may require the card issuer to maintain a card database
label: NFR

requirement_text: Currency exchange rate fluctuations may increase the card issuers liability. The card issuer must be able to adjust maximum balances to bring them in line with their policies. The card issuer may update the maximum balances as part of a load a partial unload and a currency exchange transaction. On a currency exchange transaction only the ƒ??toƒ?_x009d_ currency maximum balance may be updated
label: NFR

requirement_text: A CEP card may contain currencies that the load acquirer does not support. As a result load devices must use the alphabetic issuer-supplied currency code and currency exponent from the CEP slot(s) to display the source amounts for the currency conversion transaction
label: FR

requirement_text: Card issuers must provide an alphabetic currency code in each message that establishes a new currency. This alphabetic currency code and the currency exponent will be used by the load device to display currency balances. This allows the cardholder to identify the currency being displayed
label: FR

requirement_text: Script messages that conform to EMV specifications may be included as part of load unload and currency exchange messages from the card issuer to the CEP card. An update key must be used when card parameters are changed. Script messages may be sent to the CEP card either before or after the credit for load debit of unload and currency exchange commands
label: FR

requirement_text: All on-line messages must have the ability to include card issuer discretionary data from the CEP card
label: FR

requirement_text: The card issuer must notify the cardholder if the assessment of service fees by the card issuer during the currency exchange transaction may result in a balance of zero after the transaction has completed
label: FR

requirement_text: The card issuer must have the ability to deactivate a CEP application in the response to a load or currency exchange transaction
label: FR

requirement_text: The CEP card may support multiple currencies. Each currency occupies a ƒ??slotƒ?_x009d_ within the CEP. The slots are defined by the currency supported. The currency for an individual slot is determined during load or currency exchange. Currency exchange could apply to a single slot and then only for the total balance
label: FR

requirement_text: It is a card issuerƒ??s decision to determine the currencies that are allowed to occupy slots in the CEP card. This decision is made by the card issuer during the load or currency exchange transaction by approving or rejecting the request to authorize the transaction
label: FR

requirement_text: A single currency cannot occupy more than one slot. The CEP card must not permit a slot to be assigned a currency if another slot in the CEP card has already been assigned to that currency
label: FR

requirement_text: The CEP card limits each slot to a maximum balance. The maximum balance for a slot is established when a currency is assigned to the slot and is determined externally by the card issuer or by CEP card data which indicates a maximum balance in a reference currency. There is no requirement that all slot maximums have the same relative value and there is no requirement for the card to maintain a maximum total value
label: FR

requirement_text: Only one version of the CA public key is required in the card. This requires that the PSAMs with which the CEP card exchanges cryptograms must be capable of generating and validating cryptograms using the relevant keys from all current cards
label: NFR

requirement_text: Two-way or mutual authentication where the card authenticates the terminal and the terminal authenticates the card for each transaction must be performed for off-line transactions
label: NFR

requirement_text: For increased security and convenience asymmetric cryptography must be used as the authentication security for off-line transactions
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card must authenticate the terminal at the point of sale ensuring that it is genuine and valid and use a two-way authentication process
label: NFR

requirement_text: The terminal must authenticate the card and the transaction at the point of sale ensuring that they are genuine and valid
label: NFR

requirement_text: The terminal must participate in a two-way authentication process with the card
label: NFR

requirement_text: For cancel last purchase transactions the terminal must validate the card and sign the cancellation
label: NFR

requirement_text: The terminal must secure transactions by retaining the cardƒ??s symmetric MACing key signature as part of the transaction
label: NFR

requirement_text: The terminal must generate a symmetric MACing key signature and send it to the merchant acquirer
label: NFR

requirement_text: Incremental purchase transactions must use two-way authentication for the initial session authentication and at least one-way with the terminal authenticating the card for the remaining increments or some of the remaining increments
label: NFR

requirement_text: Load and unload functions must be authenticated using end-to-end security between the card and the card issuer
label: NFR

requirement_text: The issuer host must authenticate the card upon the load/unload request
label: NFR

requirement_text: The card must authenticate the issuer host upon the response to the request
label: NFR

requirement_text: A proof must be sent to the load acquirer that a load or unload occurred to avoid repudiation
label: NFR

requirement_text: The management of keys must be accomplished in a secure certified environment
label: NFR

requirement_text: There may be multiple certification authorities that manage keys for the system including the possibility of one overall highest level certification authority (perhaps on an international level) and domestic certification authorities for each country or region
label: NFR

requirement_text: The system must protect the integrity of key transaction data including transaction identification currency code and amount. If tampering is suspected the system must cause the transaction to fail
label: NFR

requirement_text: Expired cards must not be used for loading electronic value
label: FR

requirement_text: The time period during which a cardholder can unload electronic value perform a purchase or a currency exchange from an expired card may be determined by each issuer
label: FR

requirement_text: Consumers must be able to load electronic value to their cards at any participating load device regardless of the location provided that the currency that is requested is supported by the acquirer and the card issuer
label: FR

requirement_text: Funds issuers must accept funds authorization requests regardless of the load currency type as permitted
label: NFR

requirement_text: Load devices that are available to the general public should support multiple sources of funding and support both linked and unlinked loads
label: FR

requirement_text: Authorizations for load transactions require a form of cardholder authentication for funds requests
label: NFR

requirement_text: The load device must support on-line PIN encryption or off-line PIN verification
label: NFR

requirement_text: The load device which supports only off-line PIN verification must support both the off-line PIN encryption method and the off-line PIN plain text verification method as defined in EMV
label: NFR

requirement_text: Unload transactions do not require cardholder authentication. (However an acquirerƒ??s devices may be configured such that authentication is required for access.)
label: NFR

requirement_text: The architecture for the electronic purse should not preclude the eventual deployment of a variety of devices to meet the needs of many card acceptance environments. Unload must not be precluded from being supported on any or all of these devices at the option of the acquirer
label: FR
